commit.message:
feat(post): Mach3 Mill post for 3-axis mills

Add mach3.cps. T<n> M6 then G43 H<n>, canned cycles G73/G81/G82/G83/
G85/G86/G89 with G98, the dwell unit as a post option (seconds or
milliseconds, as Mach3's "G04 Dwell param in ms" setting), G91.1 in the
header. G41/G42, G84 tapping, probing and a G83 dwell are refused by
name.

Fixes #2482

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Merge origin/main into issue/2482-mach3-post (keep both sides)

Conflicts in the post registry and the per-post test lists: both sides
appended entries. Kept main's additions (Heidenhain Klartext, Grbl 1.1
post lists) and the PR's Mach3 entries in each list.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(post): route mach3 header notes through onComment and count 21 posts

Main's PR #3087 (issue #2996) routes post header notes through the JS
onComment hook, and every shipped post overrides it. The merge refresh of
this PR with main failed the comment_escape header-notes test because the
new mach3.cps had no override, so raw English text landed in the NC output,
and because its shipped-post count asserted 20 while the branch now ships
21. This adds the mach3 onComment override, in the form the other posts
use, and sets the count to 21.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Code <noreply@anthropic.com>

test(post): make the two stale Mach3 conformance goldens again

Main changed the slot and the zigzag pocket generators and made the
goldens of the other posts again. The Mach3 goldens of
pocket_zigzag_plate_with_island and slot_wide_channel_rows were the
old programs, so the conformance test failed on them.

WRITE_GOLDEN=1 on every_builtin_posts_every_golden_byte_exact changed
only these two files. The motion (G0/G1/G2/G3, X Y Z I J F) is the
same as the grblHAL goldens of the same parts, move for move. It is
the same as the Mach4 goldens, except for one extra G0 X Y at the
current Z of the first-traverse law (no change of position).

Refs #2482

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(app): list Mach3 with the mill posts, before Heidenhain Klartext

The merge of main put the Klartext entry from main between Mach4 and
Mach3 in BUILTINS. The conformance test lists the mill posts of
POSTS first and Klartext after them, so every_builtin_registry_entry_compiles
and every_builtin_declares_its_controls_file_extension failed. Mach3
is a mill post of POSTS: it now comes before Klartext in BUILTINS and
in EXTENSIONS. The names are the persistence contract; the order is
only the picker order.

Refs #2482

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(post): refuse a G73 or G85 dwell in the Mach3 post by name

The PECK (G73) and REAM (G85) cycles with a dwell above 0 posted with
no P word and no message: the dwell was dropped. "Using Mach3Mill"
(release 1.84) gives these formats with no P word:
10.7.22 "G73 X~ Y~ Z~ A~ B~ C~ R~ L~ Q~" and
10.7.24.6 "G85 X~ Y~ Z~ A~ B~ C~ R~ L~". G82, G86 and G89 have P~.

The script now refuses the dwell by name, in the same form as
grblhal.cps (#2609), and writes no cycle block for that hole. Mach3 is
in the post table of g73_g85_dwell_linuxcnc.rs: mach3_refuses_g73_dwell
and mach3_refuses_g85_dwell were red before this change and are green
after it. A zero dwell posts as before.

Refs #2482

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(post): set axisInversion in the Mach3 post and note a WcsFlip

assets/posts/AGENTS.md says that each built-in mill post sets
axisInversion = true. The Mach3 script did not, so the engine refused a
flipped WCS axis or an inverted machine axis by name. The script now
has the same form as grblhal.cps and mach4.cps:
- axisInversion = true in the manifest;
- the "MACHINE X+ MOVES LEFT - INVERTED AXIS" header notes;
- PARAM WcsFlip read per section, and the
  "WCS X FLIPPED - PROGRAM MIRRORED" note in the preamble, reset at
  section end.

Mach3 is in the table of wcs_flip_dialects.rs (no G41/G42, so
comp: false). The trace test reads the mirrored programs back on a
reversed controller. The new golden golden/wcs_flip/mach3_x.nc locks
the X-flipped program. An upright machine posts byte for byte the
same: the conformance goldens of Mach3 did not change.

Refs #2482

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Merge origin/main into issue/2482-mach3-post

One file had a conflict: crates/post/tests/comment_escape.rs, the count

Main (#2951) split the count into text posts (20) and the native Agie

All other files merged without a conflict (posting_files.rs BUILTINS and
embedded, conformance.rs POSTS/REFUSED/EXTENSIONS: both sides kept).

Refs #2482

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.2 <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(post): take the coincident arc guard in mach3.cps

Main (#3442 / #3471) gave every shipped post one PRELUDE rule, arcFate:
an arc record whose written ends coincide is no arc block. A control
reads such a G2/G3 with a centre off the start as a full circle.
mach3.cps came from before that change and still wrote it: with the
guard removed, coincident_arcs.rs finds blocks such as
"G3 X18.123 Y5.432 Z5.5 I-8 J0 F180" (mm) and
"G3 X0.7135 Y0.2139 Z0.2165 I-0.315 J0 F7.09" (inch), with and
without R arcs.

The form is grblhal.cps's, one for one: arcWord (a position word as
written, origin-relative) and the arcFate check at the top of
onCircular. A full turn and a normal arc post as before; a short arc
with a Z move posts as the G1 to its end; a short arc that changes
nothing writes no block.

Pinned by coincident_arcs.rs: mach3 is now a row of its table of every
shipped post (mm and inch, I/J and R mode).

Refs #2482
